import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int maxn = 20;
    static final int N = 2001000;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] b = new int[N];
    static int[] mp = new int[1 << maxn];
    static int[] tot = new int[maxn];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxn];
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = (int)((long)ans * a % mod);
            a = (int)((long)a * a % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] arr, int idx) {
        if (arr[idx] < 0) arr[idx] += mod;
        if (arr[idx] >= mod) arr[idx] -= mod;
    }

    static void fwt(int[] arr, int off, int lim) {
        if (lim == 1) return;
        lim /= 2;
        for (int i = off; i < off + lim; ++i) {
            arr[i] += arr[i + lim];
            if (arr[i] >= mod) arr[i] -= mod;
        }
        fwt(arr, off, lim);
        fwt(arr, off + lim, lim);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] arr, int off, int lim) {
        if (lim == 1) return;
        lim /= 2;
        for (int i = off; i < off + lim; ++i) {
            arr[i] -= arr[i + lim];
            if (arr[i] < 0) arr[i] += mod;
        }
        fwt2(arr, off, lim);
        fwt2(arr, off + lim, lim);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] s) {
        int n = s.length;
        int i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && s[i] >= s[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = n - 1;
        while (s[j] <= s[i]) j--;
        int tmp = s[i]; s[i] = s[j]; s[j] = tmp;
        for (int l = i + 1, r = n - 1; l < r; l++, r--) {
            tmp = s[l]; s[l] = s[r]; s[r] = tmp;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = in.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int)((long)a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        int totalMasks = 1 << n;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < totalMasks; mask++) {
            int pc = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            v[pc].add(mask);
            mp[mask] = tot[pc]++;
        }
        int m = n / 2;
        int half1 = m * n;
        int lim1 = 1 << half1;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim1; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half1; j++) {
                int bit = (i >> j) & 1;
                int val = bit == 0 ? mod + 1 - b[j] : b[j];
                if (val >= mod) val -= mod;
                p = (int)((long)p * val % mod);
            }
            int[] S = new int[m];
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int mask : v[m]) {
                int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
                int[] s = new int[cnt];
                int idx = 0;
                int k = mask;
                while (k != 0) {
                    s[idx++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k &= k - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        if ((S[j] >> s[j] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[mask];
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s));
            }
            f[st] += p;
            if (f[st] >= mod) f[st] -= mod;
        }
        int M = n - m;
        int half2 = M * n;
        int lim2 = 1 << half2;
        int fullMask = (1 << n) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim2; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            for (int j = 0; j < half2; j++) {
                int bit = (i >> j) & 1;
                int val = bit == 0 ? mod + 1 - b[j + n * m] : b[j + n * m];
                if (val >= mod) val -= mod;
                p = (int)((long)p * val % mod);
            }
            int[] S = new int[M];
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & fullMask;
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int mask : v[n - m]) {
                int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
                int[] s = new int[cnt];
                int idx = 0;
                int k = mask;
                while (k != 0) {
                    s[idx++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k &= k - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                        if ((S[j] >> s[j] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        int complement = (~mask) & fullMask;
                        st |= 1 << mp[complement];
                        break;
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s));
            }
            g[st] += p;
            if (g[st] >= mod) g[st] -= mod;
        }
        int size = 1 << tot[m];
        fwt(f, 0, size);
        fwt(g, 0, size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            f[i] = (int)((long)f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        }
        fwt2(f, 0, size);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < size; i++) {
            ans += f[i];
            if (ans >= mod) ans -= mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
